title: Advance Generated equation reliability and gold calibration
summary: Begin with the remaining human-reported gold-card typography, trajectory, handoff, pacing, and boundary defects; convert every accepted repair into a reusable invariant; then compile a stress cohort spanning expression length, signs, fractions, and division with no card-specific motion coordinates or CSS; select one timeline-wide typography and layout plan; densely gate rendered motion, ownership, boundaries, collisions, overflow, focus, accessibility, responsive fit, exact seek, and rewind; and demonstrate a controlled LLM semantic edit that either publishes through reviewed motifs or returns a typed repair.
